title: Bifrost Tag Store
description: Tag assignments stored in %APPDATA%\Bifrost\tags.json. Tags are local to each administrator's machine.

user_tags.description: Maps database login name to a list of tags assigned to that user.

items.description: Alphanumeric tag, no spaces or special characters

object_tags.description: Maps 'schema_name.object_name' to a list of tags assigned to that database object.

items.description: Alphanumeric tag, no spaces or special characters

notes: Tag keys in user_tags must match sys.database_principals.name exactly.
Tag keys in object_tags use the format 'schema_name.object_name'.
Tags are case-preserved but duplicate detection is case-insensitive.
If tags.json is missing, the application creates it with empty collections on first tag write.
Tags are never synced to SQL Server; they exist only on the local machine.
